senses.gloss: (b. h.; cmp. נָשַׁךְ)to touch closely; to kiss.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Yevamot 15:2:2">Y. Yeb. XV, 14ᵈ</cite> (ref. to <he>נשק</he>, <cite ref="Psalms 140:8">Ps. CXL, 8</cite>) <he>ביום שהקיץ נוֹשֵׁק וכ׳</he> when the summer kisses the autumn (at the change of seasons, when disease is rife).
<cite ref="Psalms 140:8">Ib.</cite> <he>ששני עולמות נוֹשְׁקִין וכ׳</he> when the two worlds touch eath other (the moment of death).

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 90:3">Gen. R. s. 90</cite>, beg. (ref. to <cite ref="Genesis 41:40">Gen. XLI, 40</cite>) <he>שלא יהא אדם נוֹשְׁקֵינִי וכ׳</he> none shall kiss me (the kiss of homage) but thou.
<cite ref="Berakhot 8b">Ber. 8ᵇ</cite>, a. e. <he>כשנוֹשְׁקִין אין נושקין אלא וכ׳</he> when they (the Medians) kiss, they do so only on the hand.
Yalk. Gen. 159 בדבר שהוא נוֹשְׁקוֹ על ערפו וכ׳ with a thing which one puts close to one’s neck, that is the bow; a. fr.—Part. pass. נָשׁוּק (cmp. אָחוּז fr. אָחַז) kissing.

<cite ref="Sotah 42b:9">Sot. 42ᵇ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Ruth 1:14">Ruth I, 14</cite>) <he>יבאו בני הנְשׁוּקָה … הדבוקה</he> let the children of her that kissed (and parted) come and fall into the hands of the children of her who clung (to Naomi); <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 156:3">Yalk. Sam. 156</cite> <he>הנְשֵׁיקָה … הדְּבֵקָה</he>.

<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 1:2:8">Cant. R. to I, 2</cite> (expl. <he>ישקני</he>, <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 1:2:8">ib.</cite>) <he>יזיינני יטהרני ידביקני</he> may he arm me (ref. to <cite ref="I Chronicles 12:2">I Chr. XII, 2</cite>), may he purify me (v. infra), may he attach me (ref. to <cite ref="Ezekiel 3:13">Ezek. III, 13</cite>).
<cite ref="Mishnah Sanhedrin 7:6">Snh. VII, 6</cite> <he>המְנַשֵּׁק</he> he who kisses (an idol); a. fr.

senses.gloss: to arm, equip. Part. pass. מְנוּשָּׁק; f. מְנוּשֶּׁקֶת, pl. מְנוּשָּׁקוֹת. Cant. R. l. c. אם עסקת … ששפתיך מנ׳ וכ׳ if thou studiest the words of the Law so that thy lips be equipped (ready for contest), all shall kiss thee &c.
to bring in close contact, to close (lips). Y. Ab. Zar. II, 41ᵈ top יש דברים שמַשִּׁיקִין וכ׳ there are things on which you must seal your mouth (v. חָשַׁק).
(Levitical law) to restore a liquid to cleanness by contact or levelling with a clean well.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Mikvaot 6:8">Mikv. VI, 8</cite> <he>מביא … ומושכו ומַשִּׁיקוֹ</he> he takes a pipe … and draws (the water from the clean pond) and makes it touch the surface of the unclean pond; <cite ref="Tosefta Mikvaot 5:5">Tosef. ib. V, 5</cite>. Cant. R. l. c. (expl. <he>ישקני</he>, may He cleanse me, v. supra) <he>כאדם שהוא מַשִּׁיק וכ׳</he> as one brings in contact or levels &c., v. <cite ref="C00033"><he>גֶּבֶא</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Mishnah Beitzah 2:3">Bets. II, 3</cite> <he>ושוין שמַשִּׁיקִין וכ׳</he> and they agree that you may (on the Holy Day) dip a vessel with an unclean liquid into a well so that the two surfaces are on a level, v. <cite ref="E00936"><he>הַשָּׁקָה</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Chullin 26a">Ḥull. 26ᵃ</cite> sq. <he>עד שלא החמיץ מַשִּׁיקוֹ וכ׳</he> before it is sour, you may cleanse it by levelling &c.; a. e.
